name: Stay the Night
desc:
🏠 Stay the Night

Cozy by day. Hunted by night.

🛒 Grab furniture from the supermarket and haul it home
✨ Make your house cozier to unlock rarer survivors
💰 Survivors move in and pay you rent
🏡 Buy bigger houses, a fence, a playground, a car port
🌙 At night the Beast prowls the streets... anyone outside gets eaten
🚪 Get home before dark!

llm.loop: by day grab furniture from the supermarket and haul it home -> cozier house unlocks rarer survivors who pay rent -> buy bigger houses and upgrades -> get home before night when the Beast hunts
llm.objectives: build a cozy house that attracts rare survivors and grow rent income while surviving the night
llm.progression: furniture, rarer survivors, rent income, bigger houses and yard upgrades
llm.instructions: grab furniture, make your house cozier, buy bigger houses, get home before dark
unique: cozy decorating tycoon with a day/night horror threat where anyone outside at night is eaten
llm.thumbnails: giant clawed creature looming over a cutaway house with a player inside at night
llm.complexity_notes: town map with supermarket, furniture placement, npc survivors, monster ai and day/night cycle
